title: Phased Terraform apply with traffic-fence and data snapshot rollback
creator: Aisha Njoroge
description: Build an automated, Terraform-driven upgrade pipeline for Private (VPC) data-plane/runtime that performs phased infra changes with an automated traffic-fence, consistent data snapshots, and a deterministic rollback path. The goal is zero-downtime for customer traffic while ensuring fast, tested rollback to a known-good state if health gates fail. Focus areas: (1) IaC multi-stage plan/promotion (plan -> canary apply -> partial apply -> full apply), (2) traffic fencing and rule promotion (layer 4/7 routing tokens + circuit breaker), (3) consistent runtime snapshotting and restore hooks (coordinator checkpoint + S3-backed archive), and (4) health gates tied to telemetry (error rate, latency p99, correctness evals) with automated abort and rollback. This ticket owns the Terraform module changes, the controller orchestration tasks, and the upgrade runbook integration with Console alerts and dashboards.
acceptance_criteria: A reproducible pipeline exists in the infra repo: terraform plan -> staged apply -> promote -> rollback
Staged apply can target a subset of nodes/tenant-slices via workspace/var selectors and updates routing via traffic fence tokens
Automated snapshot (coordinator checkpoint) is created and uploaded before any irreversible change; restore path validated in a staging rehearsal
Health gates defined: error-rate delta, p99 latency delta, eval-set regression threshold; pipeline aborts and triggers rollback if thresholds exceeded
Rollback path restores Terraform-managed infra state and triggers data-plane snapshot restore; end-to-end e2e test validates request correctness post-rollback
Integration tests in CI exercise a simulated canary apply and automated rollback (synthetic traffic + failure injection)
tasks: Design terraform module changes to support 'apply-scopes' (slice selectors) and a promotion token variable
Implement a controller (k8s job / CI step) that runs terraform plan/apply with state-locking and stores plan artifacts
Add preflight drift checks that compare remote state to expected resources and fail-fast
Wire coordinator checkpoint API to create consistent runtime snapshots; include metadata (commit, plan-id, snapshot-id)
Implement traffic-fence integration: create ephemeral routing tokens that gate production traffic to the updated slice
Implement health-gate evaluators (prometheus queries + eval harness) and implement abort/rollback hooks
Author a recovery runbook and an automated rollback play that restores tfstate + snapshot and re-enables legacy routing
Add CI scenario that replays synthetic traces and injects a failure to validate automated rollback

notes: Runbook summary: 1) Lock tfstate and create plan artifact, 2) Create coordinator snapshot (snapshot-id), 3) Mirror traffic and prewarm candidate slice, 4) Apply terraform to candidate slice and set routing token to 0.05 (5% canary), 5) Monitor health gates for 15m, 6) If pass -> increment token to 25% then 50% then 100% with waits; if fail -> trigger rollback job: set routing token to 0, reapply saved tfstate, restore snapshot to candidate nodes, run verification probes, and re-enable legacy routing. Keep audible console alerts and incident channel automation.
